lede: Indianapolis Colts carries the stronger EdgeDesk offensive profile (#15 in EPA per play) and the better defensive rating with it, so the ratings point the same way on both sides of the ball.
EdgeDesk’s independent projection makes it Indianapolis Colts -8.3 with a fair total of 44.7, before any sportsbook number is consulted.

The widest measured matchup on the board is Indianapolis Colts run offence vs Tennessee Titans run defence, which sits +0.115 from the league mean once the two ratings are combined the way the model combines them.
The largest uncertainty is quarterback information: Tennessee Titans and Indianapolis Colts have no confirmed starter on file, which materially affects how much confidence the exact number deserves.
